class Reader(int[] data, position := 0)

int power_two(int exponent)
    result := 1
    for: index < exponent
        result *= 2
    return result

int bit_width(int value)
    result := 0
    rest := value
    while rest > 0
        result += 1
        rest /= 2
    return result

int[] take(Reader &reader, int amount)
    start := reader.position
    reader.position += amount
    return reader.data[start:<reader.position]

int read_byte(Reader &reader)
    result := reader.data[reader.position]
    reader.position += 1
    return result

int[] uleb(int value)
    int[] output := []
    rest := value
    while rest >= 128
        output = output.append(rest % 128 + 128)
        rest /= 128
    return output.append(rest)

int read_uleb(Reader &reader)
    result := 0
    multiplier := 1
    while true
        part := read_byte(&reader)
        result += (part % 128) * multiplier
        if part < 128
            return result
        multiplier *= 128
    return result

int[] zigzag(int value)
    return uleb(if value >= 0 then value * 2 else -value * 2 - 1)

int read_zigzag(Reader &reader)
    value := read_uleb(&reader)
    return if value % 2 == 0 then value / 2 else -(value + 1) / 2

int[] integer_bytes(int value, count := 4)
    rest := if value < 0 then value + 4294967296 else value
    int[] result := []
    for: index < count
        result = result.append(rest % 256)
        rest /= 256
    return result

int read_integer(Reader &reader, count := 4, signed_value := false)
    result := 0
    multiplier := 1
    for: index < count
        result += read_byte(&reader) * multiplier
        multiplier *= 256
    return if signed_value and result >= 2147483648 then result - 4294967296 else result

int[] pack(int[] values, int width)
    output := array(nat(int(#values) * width / 8), fill = 0)
    for: index < int(#values)
        rest := values[index]
        for: shift < width
            bit := index * width + shift
            output[bit / 8] += (rest % 2) * power_two(bit % 8)
            rest /= 2
    return output

int[] unpack(Reader &reader, int width, int count)
    data := take(&reader, count * width / 8)
    int[] output := []
    for: index < count
        value := 0
        for: shift < width
            bit := index * width + shift
            value += (data[bit / 8] / power_two(bit % 8) % 2) * power_two(shift)
        output = output.append(value)
    return output

int adler32(int[] data)
    first := 1
    second := 0
    for value := data[]
        first = (first + value) % 65521
        second = (second + first) % 65521
    return second * 65536 + first

int run_length(int[] values, int start)
    end := start + 1
    while end < int(#values) and values[end] == values[start]
        end += 1
    return end - start

int[] hybrid_encode(int[] values, int width)
    int[] output := []
    offset := 0
    count := int(#values)
    while offset < count
        length := run_length(values, offset)
        if length >= 8
            output = output.concat(uleb(length * 2)).concat(integer_bytes(values[offset], (width + 7) / 8))
            offset += length
        else
            end := offset
            groups := 0
            while true
                end += 8
                groups += 1
                if end >= count or groups == 63 or run_length(values, end) >= 8
                    break
            block := [for index := (offset:<end)[] then if index < count then values[index] else 0]
            output = output.concat(uleb(groups * 2 + 1)).concat(pack(block, width))
            offset = end
    return output

int[] hybrid_decode(Reader &reader, int width, int count)
    int[] output := []
    while int(#output) < count
        header := read_uleb(&reader)
        if header % 2 == 0
            value := read_integer(&reader, (width + 7) / 8)
            output = output.concat(array(nat(header / 2), fill = value))
        else
            output = output.concat(unpack(&reader, width, (header - 1) / 2 * 8))
    return output[0:<count]

import math
import schema_io = "./schema_io.qui"
import bitstream = "./bitstream.qui"

string[] method_names()
    return ["PLAIN", "DICTIONARY", "RLE", "DELTA_BINARY_PACKED", "DELTA_LENGTH_BYTE_ARRAY"]
string[] type_names()
    return ["INT", "STRING", "BOOL", "DATE"]
class Bounds(present := false, low := schema_io.Cell(), high := schema_io.Cell())

int method_number(string name)
    for: index < int(#method_names())
        if method_names()[index] == name
            return index
    return -1

int type_number(string kind)
    for: index < int(#type_names())
        if type_names()[index] == kind
            return index
    return 0

int[] candidates(string kind)
    return if kind == "BOOL" then [0, 2] elif kind == "STRING" then [0, 1, 4] else [0, 1, 3]

int[] delta_encode(int[] values)
    count := int(#values)
    int[] output := bitstream.uleb(128).concat(bitstream.uleb(4)).concat(bitstream.uleb(count)).concat(bitstream.zigzag(if count == 0 then 0 else values[0]))
    offset := 1
    while offset < count
        end := math.min(offset + 128, count)
        differences := [for index := (offset:<end)[] then values[index] - values[index - 1]]
        minimum := differences.sorted()[0]
        output = output.concat(bitstream.zigzag(minimum))
        int[][] blocks := []
        int[] widths := []
        for: mini < 4
            start := mini * 32
            length := math.max(0, math.min(32, int(#differences) - start))
            block := [for index := (0:<length)[] then differences[start + index] - minimum]
            width := if length == 0 then 0 else bitstream.bit_width(block.sorted(descending = true)[0])
            widths = widths.append(width)
            if length > 0
                block = block.concat(array(nat(32 - length), fill = 0))
            blocks = blocks.append(block)
        output = output.concat(widths)
        for: mini < 4
            if #blocks[mini] > 0
                output = output.concat(bitstream.pack(blocks[mini], widths[mini]))
        offset = end
    return output

int[] delta_decode(bitstream.Reader &reader)
    bitstream.read_uleb(&reader)
    bitstream.read_uleb(&reader)
    count := bitstream.read_uleb(&reader)
    first := bitstream.read_zigzag(&reader)
    int[] output := if count == 0 then [] else [first]
    while int(#output) < count
        minimum := bitstream.read_zigzag(&reader)
        widths := bitstream.take(&reader, 4)
        for: mini < 4
            remaining := count - int(#output)
            if remaining <= 0
                break
            block := bitstream.unpack(&reader, widths[mini], 32)
            for: index < math.min(32, remaining)
                output = output.append(output[-1] + minimum + block[index])
    return output

int[] encode_values(string kind, int method, schema_io.Cell[] values, schema_io.Cell[] dictionary := [])
    int[] output := []
    if method == 0
        if kind == "BOOL"
            count := (int(#values) + 7) / 8 * 8
            return bitstream.pack([for index := (0:<count)[] then if index < int(#values) then values[index].number else 0], 1)
        for value := values[]
            if kind == "STRING"
                output = output.concat(bitstream.integer_bytes(int(#value.text))).concat(schema_io.ascii_bytes(value.text))
            else
                output = output.concat(bitstream.integer_bytes(value.number))
    elif method == 1
        width := bitstream.bit_width(int(#dictionary) - 1)
        int[] indices := []
        for value := values[]
            for: rank < int(#dictionary)
                if schema_io.compare_cells(value, dictionary[rank]) == 0
                    indices = indices.append(rank)
                    break
        output = [width].concat(bitstream.hybrid_encode(indices, width))
    elif method == 2
        body := bitstream.hybrid_encode([for value := values[] then value.number], 1)
        output = bitstream.integer_bytes(int(#body)).concat(body)
    elif method == 3
        output = delta_encode([for value := values[] then value.number])
    else
        output = delta_encode([for value := values[] then int(#value.text)])
        for value := values[]
            output = output.concat(schema_io.ascii_bytes(value.text))
    return output

schema_io.Cell[] decode_values(bitstream.Reader &reader, string kind, int method, int count, schema_io.Cell[] dictionary := [])
    schema_io.Cell[] output := []
    if method == 0
        if kind == "BOOL"
            values := bitstream.unpack(&reader, 1, (count + 7) / 8 * 8)
            return [for index := (0:<count)[] then schema_io.Cell(false, values[index], kind = kind)]
        for: index < count
            if kind == "STRING"
                length := bitstream.read_integer(&reader)
                output = output.append(schema_io.Cell(false, text = schema_io.ascii_text(bitstream.take(&reader, length)), kind = kind))
            else
                output = output.append(schema_io.Cell(false, bitstream.read_integer(&reader, signed_value = true), kind = kind))
    elif method == 1
        width := bitstream.read_byte(&reader)
        indices := bitstream.hybrid_decode(&reader, width, count)
        output = [for rank := indices[] then dictionary[rank]]
    elif method == 2
        bitstream.read_integer(&reader)
        output = [for value := bitstream.hybrid_decode(&reader, 1, count)[] then schema_io.Cell(false, value, kind = kind)]
    elif method == 3
        output = [for value := delta_decode(&reader)[] then schema_io.Cell(false, value, kind = kind)]
    else
        lengths := delta_decode(&reader)
        output = [for length := lengths[] then schema_io.Cell(false, text = schema_io.ascii_text(bitstream.take(&reader, length)), kind = kind)]
    return output

int[] write_statistic(schema_io.Cell value)
    if value.kind == "STRING"
        return bitstream.uleb(int(#value.text)).concat(schema_io.ascii_bytes(value.text))
    if value.kind == "BOOL"
        return [value.number]
    return bitstream.zigzag(value.number)

schema_io.Cell read_statistic(bitstream.Reader &reader, string kind)
    if kind == "STRING"
        length := bitstream.read_uleb(&reader)
        return schema_io.Cell(false, text = schema_io.ascii_text(bitstream.take(&reader, length)), kind = kind)
    return schema_io.Cell(false, if kind == "BOOL" then bitstream.read_byte(&reader) else bitstream.read_zigzag(&reader), kind = kind)

int[] write_bounds(Bounds bounds)
    return if bounds.present then [1].concat(write_statistic(bounds.low)).concat(write_statistic(bounds.high)) else [0]

Bounds read_bounds(bitstream.Reader &reader, string kind)
    if bitstream.read_byte(&reader) == 0
        return Bounds()
    low := read_statistic(&reader, kind)
    high := read_statistic(&reader, kind)
    return Bounds(true, low, high)

Bounds bounds_of(schema_io.Cell[] values)
    result := Bounds()
    for value := values[]
        if value.is_null
            continue
        if not result.present
            result = Bounds(true, value, value)
        else
            if schema_io.compare_cells(value, result.low) < 0
                result.low = value
            if schema_io.compare_cells(value, result.high) > 0
                result.high = value
    return result

string bounds_text(Bounds bounds)
    return if bounds.present then "min " + schema_io.cell_text(bounds.low) + " max " + schema_io.cell_text(bounds.high) else "stats none"

import collections
import math
import schema_io = "./schema_io.qui"
import bitstream = "./bitstream.qui"
import encoding = "./encoding.qui"
import query = "./query.qui"

class Page(kind := 0, method := 0, values := 0, nulls := 0, offset := 0, header_bytes := 0, body_bytes := 0, checksum := 0, bounds := encoding.Bounds())
class Chunk(int offset, int size, int[] methods, bool has_dictionary, int page_count, int nulls, encoding.Bounds bounds)
    dictionary := Page()
    Page[] pages := []
class RowGroup(int rows, int first_row, Chunk[] chunks)
class Store(int[] data, schema_io.Column[] columns, int rows, RowGroup[] groups, int footer_offset, int footer_bytes, version := 1)
class Candidate(int[] data, int fallback_pages, int dictionary_pages, int[] methods)
class Built(int[] data, string[] report)
class Zone(encoding.Bounds bounds, int nulls, int count)
class Plan(query.Parsed parsed, int[] item_columns, int[] condition_columns, int[] needed, int[] comparison_columns, string[] headers, int group, int order, bool aggregate)
class Checked(string error_code, Plan plan)
class Scan(schema_io.Cell[][] rows, int[] counts, string[] records)
class Result(string kind, int matched, string[] lines)

string method_list(int[] methods)
    return [for method := methods[] then encoding.method_names()[method]].join(",")

string column_line(int index, schema_io.Column column)
    return "column {index} {column.name} {column.kind} " + (if column.nullable then "NULLABLE" else "REQUIRED")

int count_nulls(schema_io.Cell[] values)
    result := 0
    for value := values[]
        if value.is_null
            result += 1
    return result

int[] make_page(schema_io.Column column, int kind, int method, schema_io.Cell[] values, schema_io.Cell[] dictionary := [])
    int[] body := []
    nulls := if kind == 1 then 0 else count_nulls(values)
    bounds := if kind == 1 then encoding.Bounds() else encoding.bounds_of(values)
    if kind == 0 and column.nullable
        definitions := bitstream.hybrid_encode([for value := values[] then if value.is_null then 0 else 1], 1)
        body = bitstream.integer_bytes(int(#definitions)).concat(definitions)
    body = body.concat(encoding.encode_values(column.kind, method, [for value := values[] if not value.is_null then value], dictionary))
    return [kind, method].concat(bitstream.uleb(int(#values))).concat(bitstream.uleb(nulls)).concat(bitstream.uleb(int(#body))).concat(bitstream.integer_bytes(bitstream.adler32(body))).concat(encoding.write_bounds(bounds)).concat(body)

Candidate make_chunk(schema_io.Column column, schema_io.Cell[] values, int method, schema_io.Options options)
    schema_io.Cell[][] pages := []
    start := 0
    while start < int(#values)
        end := math.min(start + options.page_size, int(#values))
        pages = pages.append(values[start:<end])
        start = end
    schema_io.Cell[] dictionary := []
    dictionary_pages := 0
    if method == 1
        for page_values := pages[]
            expanded := dictionary
            distinct<string> known
            for value := dictionary[]
                .known.add(schema_io.cell_text(value))
            for value := page_values[]
                if not value.is_null and not known.has(schema_io.cell_text(value))
                    .known.add(schema_io.cell_text(value))
                    expanded = expanded.append(value)
            if int(#encoding.encode_values(column.kind, 0, expanded)) > options.dictionary_limit
                break
            dictionary = expanded
            dictionary_pages += 1
        if #dictionary == 0
            dictionary_pages = 0
    int[] data := if dictionary_pages > 0 then make_page(column, 1, 0, dictionary) else []
    distinct<int> used
    for: page_index < int(#pages)
        page_method := if method == 1 then (if page_index < dictionary_pages then 1 else 0) else method
        .used.add(page_method)
        data = data.concat(make_page(column, 0, page_method, pages[page_index], dictionary))
    return Candidate(data, if method == 1 then int(#pages) - dictionary_pages else 0, dictionary_pages, used.sorted())

Built build_file(schema_io.Inputs inputs)
    data := schema_io.ascii_bytes("MPTC")
    report := ["row_group,column,encoding,bytes,fallback_pages,chosen"]
    RowGroup[] groups := []
    start := 0
    while start < int(#inputs.rows)
        int end := math.min(start + inputs.settings.row_group_size, int(#inputs.rows))
        Chunk[] chunks := []
        group_number := int(#groups)
        for: column_index < int(#inputs.columns)
            schema_io.Column column := inputs.columns[column_index]
            schema_io.Cell[] values := [for row := (start:<end)[] then inputs.rows[row][column_index]]
            choices := encoding.candidates(column.kind)
            encoded := [for method := choices[] then make_chunk(column, values, method, inputs.settings)]
            chosen := 0
            if inputs.settings.methods[column_index] == "AUTO"
                for: index < int(#choices)
                    if #encoded[index].data < #encoded[chosen].data
                        chosen = index
            else
                for: index < int(#choices)
                    if encoding.method_names()[choices[index]] == inputs.settings.methods[column_index]
                        chosen = index
            if choices[chosen] == 1 and encoded[chosen].dictionary_pages == 0
                chosen = 0
            for: index < int(#choices)
                report = report.append("{group_number},{column.name},{encoding.method_names()[choices[index]]},{#encoded[index].data},{encoded[index].fallback_pages}," + (if index == chosen then "yes" else "no"))
            selected := encoded[chosen]
            chunks = chunks.append(Chunk(int(#data), int(#selected.data), selected.methods, selected.dictionary_pages > 0, (end - start + inputs.settings.page_size - 1) / inputs.settings.page_size, count_nulls(values), encoding.bounds_of(values)))
            data = data.concat(selected.data)
        groups = groups.append(RowGroup(end - start, start, chunks))
        start = end
    int[] footer := bitstream.uleb(1).concat(bitstream.uleb(int(#inputs.columns)))
    for column := inputs.columns[]
        footer = footer.concat(bitstream.uleb(int(#column.name))).concat(schema_io.ascii_bytes(column.name)).concat([encoding.type_number(column.kind), if column.nullable then 1 else 0])
    footer = footer.concat(bitstream.uleb(int(#inputs.rows))).concat(bitstream.uleb(int(#groups)))
    for group := groups[]
        footer = footer.concat(bitstream.uleb(group.rows))
        for chunk := group.chunks[]
            footer = footer.concat(bitstream.uleb(chunk.offset)).concat(bitstream.uleb(chunk.size)).concat(bitstream.uleb(int(#chunk.methods))).concat(chunk.methods).concat([if chunk.has_dictionary then 1 else 0]).concat(bitstream.uleb(chunk.page_count)).concat(bitstream.uleb(chunk.nulls)).concat(encoding.write_bounds(chunk.bounds))
    data = data.concat(footer).concat(bitstream.integer_bytes(int(#footer))).concat(schema_io.ascii_bytes("MPTC"))
    return Built(data, report)

Page parse_page(bitstream.Reader &reader, string kind)
    offset := reader.position
    page_kind := bitstream.read_byte(&reader)
    method := bitstream.read_byte(&reader)
    values := bitstream.read_uleb(&reader)
    nulls := bitstream.read_uleb(&reader)
    body_bytes := bitstream.read_uleb(&reader)
    checksum := bitstream.read_integer(&reader)
    bounds := encoding.read_bounds(&reader, kind)
    header_bytes := reader.position - offset
    reader.position += body_bytes
    return Page(page_kind, method, values, nulls, offset, header_bytes, body_bytes, checksum, bounds)

Store parse_file(int[] data)
    trailer := bitstream.Reader(data, int(#data) - 8)
    footer_bytes := bitstream.read_integer(&trailer)
    footer_offset := int(#data) - 8 - footer_bytes
    reader := bitstream.Reader(data, footer_offset)
    version := bitstream.read_uleb(&reader)
    columns_count := bitstream.read_uleb(&reader)
    schema_io.Column[] columns := []
    for: index < columns_count
        length := bitstream.read_uleb(&reader)
        name := schema_io.ascii_text(bitstream.take(&reader, length))
        kind := bitstream.read_byte(&reader)
        nullable := bitstream.read_byte(&reader) == 1
        columns = columns.append(schema_io.Column(name, encoding.type_names()[kind], nullable))
    rows := bitstream.read_uleb(&reader)
    group_count := bitstream.read_uleb(&reader)
    RowGroup[] groups := []
    first_row := 0
    for: group_index < group_count
        group_rows := bitstream.read_uleb(&reader)
        Chunk[] chunks := []
        for: column_index < columns_count
            offset := bitstream.read_uleb(&reader)
            size := bitstream.read_uleb(&reader)
            method_count := bitstream.read_uleb(&reader)
            methods := bitstream.take(&reader, method_count)
            dictionary := bitstream.read_byte(&reader) == 1
            page_count := bitstream.read_uleb(&reader)
            nulls := bitstream.read_uleb(&reader)
            bounds := encoding.read_bounds(&reader, columns[column_index].kind)
            chunk := Chunk(offset, size, methods, dictionary, page_count, nulls, bounds)
            pages := bitstream.Reader(data, offset)
            while pages.position < offset + size
                page := parse_page(&pages, columns[column_index].kind)
                if page.kind == 1
                    chunk.dictionary = page
                else
                    chunk.pages = chunk.pages.append(page)
            chunks = chunks.append(chunk)
        groups = groups.append(RowGroup(group_rows, first_row, chunks))
        first_row += group_rows
    return Store(data, columns, rows, groups, footer_offset, footer_bytes, version)

int[] page_body(Store store, Page page)
    return store.data[page.offset + page.header_bytes:<(page.offset + page.header_bytes + page.body_bytes)]

schema_io.Cell[] decode_dictionary(Store store, schema_io.Column column, Page page)
    reader := bitstream.Reader(page_body(store, page))
    return encoding.decode_values(&reader, column.kind, 0, page.values)

schema_io.Cell[] decode_page(Store store, schema_io.Column column, Page page, schema_io.Cell[] dictionary)
    reader := bitstream.Reader(page_body(store, page))
    definitions := array(nat(page.values), fill = 1)
    if column.nullable
        size := bitstream.read_integer(&reader)
        position := reader.position
        definitions = bitstream.hybrid_decode(&reader, 1, page.values)
        reader.position = position + size
    count := 0
    for level := definitions[]
        count += level
    values := encoding.decode_values(&reader, column.kind, page.method, count, dictionary)
    schema_io.Cell[] result := []
    position := 0
    for level := definitions[]
        if level == 0
            result = result.append(schema_io.Cell(kind = column.kind))
        else
            result = result.append(values[position])
            position += 1
    return result

string[] describe(Store store, schema_io.Cell[][] originals)
    lines := ["file bytes {#store.data} footer_offset {store.footer_offset} footer_bytes {store.footer_bytes}", "table version {store.version} rows {store.rows} columns {#store.columns} row_groups {#store.groups}"]
    for: index < int(#store.columns)
        lines = lines.append(column_line(index, store.columns[index]))
    sizes := array(#store.columns, fill = 0)
    data_pages := array(#store.columns, fill = 0)
    dictionary_pages := array(#store.columns, fill = 0)
    used := [for column := store.columns[] then array(5, fill = false)]
    cells := 0
    nulls := 0
    mismatches := 0
    checksum_errors := 0
    for: group_index < int(#store.groups)
        group := store.groups[group_index]
        total_bytes := 0
        for chunk := group.chunks[]
            total_bytes += chunk.size
        lines = lines.append("row_group {group_index} rows {group.rows} first_row {group.first_row} bytes {total_bytes}")
        for: column_index < int(#store.columns)
            column := store.columns[column_index]
            chunk := group.chunks[column_index]
            sizes[column_index] += chunk.size
            data_pages[column_index] += chunk.page_count
            for method := chunk.methods[]
                used[column_index][method] = true
            lines = lines.append("chunk {group_index} {column.name} offset {chunk.offset} size {chunk.size} encodings {method_list(chunk.methods)} dictionary " + (if chunk.has_dictionary then "yes" else "no") + " pages {chunk.page_count} nulls {chunk.nulls} {encoding.bounds_text(chunk.bounds)}")
            schema_io.Cell[] dictionary := []
            if chunk.has_dictionary
                Page page := chunk.dictionary
                dictionary_pages[column_index] += 1
                if bitstream.adler32(page_body(store, page)) != page.checksum
                    checksum_errors += 1
                dictionary = decode_dictionary(store, column, page)
                lines = lines.append("page {group_index} {column.name} dict offset {page.offset} header {page.header_bytes} body {page.body_bytes} checksum {schema_io.hex_text(page.checksum, 8)} entries {page.values}")
            row := group.first_row
            for: page_index < int(#chunk.pages)
                page := chunk.pages[page_index]
                if bitstream.adler32(page_body(store, page)) != page.checksum
                    checksum_errors += 1
                lines = lines.append("page {group_index} {column.name} {page_index} offset {page.offset} header {page.header_bytes} body {page.body_bytes} checksum {schema_io.hex_text(page.checksum, 8)} encoding {encoding.method_names()[page.method]} values {page.values} nulls {page.nulls} {encoding.bounds_text(page.bounds)}")
                for value := decode_page(store, column, page, dictionary)[]
                    cells += 1
                    if value.is_null
                        nulls += 1
                    if schema_io.compare_cells(value, originals[row][column_index]) != 0
                        mismatches += 1
                    row += 1
    for: index < int(#store.columns)
        methods := [for method := (int(0):<5)[] if used[index][method] then method]
        lines = lines.append("summary {store.columns[index].name} bytes {sizes[index]} data_pages {data_pages[index]} dictionary_pages {dictionary_pages[index]} encodings {method_list(methods)}")
    status := if mismatches == 0 and checksum_errors == 0 then "ok" else "failed"
    return lines.append("roundtrip {status} cells {cells} nulls {nulls} mismatches {mismatches} checksum_errors {checksum_errors}")

int find_column(schema_io.Column[] columns, string name)
    for: index < int(#columns)
        if columns[index].name == name
            return index
    return -1

string item_header(query.Item item)
    if item.operation == "COLUMN"
        return item.name
    if item.operation == "COUNT_DISTINCT"
        return "COUNT(DISTINCT {item.name})"
    return item.operation + "(" + (if item.name == "" then "*" else item.name) + ")"

Checked check_query(query.Parsed parsed, schema_io.Column[] columns)
    if #parsed.items == 0
        parsed.items = [for column := columns[] then query.Item("COLUMN", column.name)]
    string[] names := [for item := parsed.items[] if item.name != "" then item.name]
    for node := parsed.nodes[]
        if node.name != ""
            names = names.append(node.name)
    if parsed.group != ""
        names = names.append(parsed.group)
    if parsed.order != ""
        names = names.append(parsed.order)
    plan := Plan(parsed, [], [], [], [], [], -1, -1, false)
    for name := names[]
        if find_column(columns, name) < 0
            return Checked("unknown_column", plan)
    for node := parsed.nodes[]
        if node.name == ""
            continue
        kind := columns[find_column(columns, node.name)].kind
        expected := if kind == "DATE" then "STRING" else kind
        for value := node.literals[]
            if value.kind != expected
                return Checked("type_mismatch", plan)
    for item := parsed.items[]
        if (item.operation == "SUM" or item.operation == "AVG") and columns[find_column(columns, item.name)].kind != "INT"
            return Checked("bad_aggregate", plan)
    plan.aggregate = parsed.group != ""
    for item := parsed.items[]
        if item.operation != "COLUMN"
            plan.aggregate = true
    if plan.aggregate
        for item := parsed.items[]
            if item.operation == "COLUMN" and item.name != parsed.group
                return Checked("not_grouped", plan)
        if parsed.order != ""
            return Checked("bad_order", plan)
    needed := array(#columns, fill = false)
    condition_needed := array(#columns, fill = false)
    for name := names[]
        needed[find_column(columns, name)] = true
    for: node_index < int(#plan.parsed.nodes)
        query.Condition node := plan.parsed.nodes[node_index]
        index := if node.name == "" then -1 else find_column(columns, node.name)
        plan.comparison_columns = plan.comparison_columns.append(index)
        if index >= 0
            condition_needed[index] = true
            if columns[index].kind == "DATE"
                for: literal_index < int(#node.literals)
                    node.literals[literal_index] = schema_io.parse_cell("DATE", node.literals[literal_index].text)
                plan.parsed.nodes[node_index] = node
    plan.needed = [for index := (0:<(int(#columns)))[] if needed[index] then index]
    plan.condition_columns = [for index := (0:<(int(#columns)))[] if condition_needed[index] then index]
    plan.item_columns = [for item := parsed.items[] then if item.name == "" then -1 else find_column(columns, item.name)]
    plan.headers = [for item := parsed.items[] then item_header(item)]
    plan.group = if parsed.group == "" then -1 else find_column(columns, parsed.group)
    plan.order = if parsed.order == "" then -1 else find_column(columns, parsed.order)
    return Checked("", plan)

int tri_not(int value)
    return if value == 2 then 2 else 1 - value

int tri_pair(string operation, int first, int second)
    if operation == "AND"
        return if first == 0 or second == 0 then 0 elif first == 2 or second == 2 then 2 else 1
    return if first == 1 or second == 1 then 1 elif first == 2 or second == 2 then 2 else 0

bool comparison(string operation, schema_io.Cell value, schema_io.Cell[] literals)
    if operation == "BETWEEN"
        return schema_io.compare_cells(literals[0], value) <= 0 and schema_io.compare_cells(value, literals[1]) <= 0
    if operation == "IN"
        for candidate := literals[]
            if schema_io.compare_cells(value, candidate) == 0
                return true
        return false
    relation := schema_io.compare_cells(value, literals[0])
    if operation == "="
        return relation == 0
    if operation == "<>"
        return relation != 0
    if operation == "<"
        return relation < 0
    if operation == "<="
        return relation <= 0
    if operation == ">"
        return relation > 0
    return relation >= 0

int evaluate(Plan plan, schema_io.Cell[] row)
    if plan.parsed.root < 0
        return 1
    int[] results := []
    for: index < int(#plan.parsed.nodes)
        query.Condition node := plan.parsed.nodes[index]
        value := 0
        if node.operation == "NOT"
            value = tri_not(results[node.left])
        elif node.operation == "AND" or node.operation == "OR"
            value = tri_pair(node.operation, results[node.left], results[node.right])
        else
            cell := row[plan.comparison_columns[index]]
            if node.operation == "IS_NULL" or node.operation == "IS_NOT_NULL"
                value = if cell.is_null == (node.operation == "IS_NULL") then 1 else 0
            elif cell.is_null
                value = 2
            else
                value = if comparison(node.operation, cell, node.literals) then 1 else 0
        results = results.append(value)
    return results[plan.parsed.root]

bool[] zone_leaf(query.Condition node, Zone zone)
    result := [false, false, false]
    if node.operation == "IS_NULL" or node.operation == "IS_NOT_NULL"
        test_null := node.operation == "IS_NULL"
        result[if test_null then 1 else 0] = zone.nulls > 0
        result[if test_null then 0 else 1] = zone.nulls < zone.count
        return result
    result[2] = zone.nulls > 0
    if not zone.bounds.present
        return result
    low := zone.bounds.low
    high := zone.bounds.high
    can_true := false
    can_false := false
    if node.operation == "BETWEEN"
        can_true = schema_io.compare_cells(low, node.literals[1]) <= 0 and schema_io.compare_cells(high, node.literals[0]) >= 0 and schema_io.compare_cells(node.literals[0], node.literals[1]) <= 0
        can_false = schema_io.compare_cells(low, node.literals[0]) < 0 or schema_io.compare_cells(high, node.literals[1]) > 0
    elif node.operation == "IN"
        for value := node.literals[]
            if schema_io.compare_cells(low, value) <= 0 and schema_io.compare_cells(value, high) <= 0
                can_true = true
        can_false = not (schema_io.compare_cells(low, high) == 0 and comparison("IN", low, node.literals))
    else
        first := schema_io.compare_cells(low, node.literals[0])
        last := schema_io.compare_cells(high, node.literals[0])
        if node.operation == "=" or node.operation == "<>"
            can_true = first <= 0 and last >= 0
            can_false = not (first == 0 and last == 0)
            if node.operation == "<>"
                temporary := can_true
                can_true = can_false
                can_false = temporary
        elif node.operation == "<"
            can_true = first < 0
            can_false = last >= 0
        elif node.operation == "<="
            can_true = first <= 0
            can_false = last > 0
        elif node.operation == ">"
            can_true = last > 0
            can_false = first <= 0
        else
            can_true = last >= 0
            can_false = first < 0
    result[0] = can_false
    result[1] = can_true
    return result

bool zone_possible(Plan plan, Zone[] zones)
    if plan.parsed.root < 0
        return true
    bool[][] results := []
    for: index < int(#plan.parsed.nodes)
        query.Condition node := plan.parsed.nodes[index]
        values := [false, false, false]
        if node.operation == "NOT"
            for: value < 3
                if results[node.left][value]
                    values[tri_not(value)] = true
        elif node.operation == "AND" or node.operation == "OR"
            for: first < 3
                for: second < 3
                    if results[node.left][first] and results[node.right][second]
                        values[tri_pair(node.operation, first, second)] = true
        else
            values = zone_leaf(node, zones[plan.comparison_columns[index]])
        results = results.append(values)
    return results[plan.parsed.root][1]

schema_io.Cell[] scan_page(Store store, int group_index, int column_index_value, int page_index, map<(int, int), schema_io.Cell[]> &dictionaries, int[] &counts)
    column := store.columns[column_index_value]
    chunk := store.groups[group_index].chunks[column_index_value]
    page := chunk.pages[page_index]
    schema_io.Cell[] dictionary := []
    if page.method == 1
        (int, int) key := (group_index, column_index_value)
        if not dictionaries.has(key)
            .dictionaries.set(key, decode_dictionary(store, column, chunk.dictionary))
            counts[5] += 1
            counts[6] += chunk.dictionary.header_bytes + chunk.dictionary.body_bytes
        match dictionaries.get(key)
            schema_io.Cell[] found
                dictionary = found
            none
                dictionary = []
    counts[2] += 1
    counts[6] += page.header_bytes + page.body_bytes
    return decode_page(store, column, page, dictionary)

Scan scan_store(Store store, Plan plan)
    counts := array(9, fill = 0)
    string[] records := []
    schema_io.Cell[][] matched := []
    map<(int, int), schema_io.Cell[]> dictionaries
    distinct<int> conditions
    for index := plan.condition_columns[]
        .conditions.add(index)
    remaining := [for index := plan.needed[] if not conditions.has(index) then index]
    for: group_index < int(#store.groups)
        group := store.groups[group_index]
        zones := [for chunk := group.chunks[] then Zone(chunk.bounds, chunk.nulls, group.rows)]
        if not zone_possible(plan, zones)
            counts[1] += 1
            records = records.append("")
            continue
        counts[0] += 1
        if #plan.needed == 0
            counts[7] += group.rows
            matched = matched.concat([for row := (0:<(group.rows))[] then array(#store.columns, fill = schema_io.Cell())])
            records = records.append("-")
            continue
        record := ""
        for: page_index < group.chunks[0].page_count
            zones = [for chunk := group.chunks[] then Zone(chunk.pages[page_index].bounds, chunk.pages[page_index].nulls, chunk.pages[page_index].values)]
            if not zone_possible(plan, zones)
                counts[3] += int(#plan.needed)
                record += "s"
                continue
            row_count := group.chunks[0].pages[page_index].values
            counts[7] += row_count
            rows := [for row := (0:<row_count)[] then array(#store.columns, fill = schema_io.Cell())]
            for index := plan.condition_columns[]
                decoded := scan_page(store, group_index, index, page_index, &dictionaries, &counts)
                for: row < row_count
                    rows[row][index] = decoded[row]
            selected := [for row := (0:<row_count)[] if evaluate(plan, rows[row]) == 1 then row]
            if #selected == 0 and #remaining > 0
                counts[4] += int(#remaining)
                record += "u"
                continue
            for index := remaining[]
                decoded := scan_page(store, group_index, index, page_index, &dictionaries, &counts)
                for: row < row_count
                    rows[row][index] = decoded[row]
            matched = matched.concat([for row := selected[] then rows[row]])
            record += "r"
        records = records.append(record)
    counts[8] = int(#matched)
    return Scan(matched, counts, records)

int[] ordered_rows(schema_io.Cell[][] rows, int column_number, bool descending)
    indices := [for index := (0:<(int(#rows)))[] then index]
    present := [for row := rows[] then not row[column_number].is_null]
    numbers := [for row := rows[] then row[column_number].number]
    texts := [for row := rows[] then row[column_number].text]
    return indices.sorted(by = (present, numbers, texts), descending = descending)

int greatest_common_divisor(int first, int second)
    left := if first < 0 then -first else first
    right := second
    while right != 0
        left, right = right, left % right
    return left

string aggregate_value(query.Item item, int column_number, schema_io.Cell[][] rows, schema_io.Cell key)
    if item.operation == "COLUMN"
        return schema_io.cell_text(key)
    if item.operation == "COUNT" and column_number < 0
        return "{#rows}"
    values := [for row := rows[] if not row[column_number].is_null then row[column_number]]
    if item.operation == "COUNT"
        return "{#values}"
    if item.operation == "COUNT_DISTINCT"
        distinct<string> unique
        for value := values[]
            .unique.add(schema_io.cell_text(value))
        return "{unique.size()}"
    if #values == 0
        return "NULL"
    if item.operation == "SUM" or item.operation == "AVG"
        total := 0
        for value := values[]
            total += value.number
        if item.operation == "SUM"
            return "{total}"
        divisor := greatest_common_divisor(total, int(#values))
        numerator := total / divisor
        denominator := int(#values) / divisor
        return if denominator == 1 then "{numerator}" else "{numerator}/{denominator}"
    best := values[0]
    for value := values[]
        relation := schema_io.compare_cells(value, best)
        if (item.operation == "MIN" and relation < 0) or (item.operation == "MAX" and relation > 0)
            best = value
    return schema_io.cell_text(best)

Result build_result(Plan plan, schema_io.Cell[][] matched)
    kind := if not plan.aggregate then "rows" elif plan.group >= 0 then "grouped" else "aggregate"
    string[] output := []
    if not plan.aggregate
        indices := [for index := (0:<(int(#matched)))[] then index]
        if plan.order >= 0
            indices = ordered_rows(matched, plan.order, plan.parsed.descending)
        for index := indices[]
            output = output.append([for column_number := plan.item_columns[] then schema_io.cell_text(matched[index][column_number])].join(","))
    else
        schema_io.Cell[][][] groups := []
        schema_io.Cell[] keys := []
        if plan.group < 0
            groups = [matched]
            keys = [schema_io.Cell()]
        else
            indices := ordered_rows(matched, plan.group, false)
            for index := indices[]
                key := matched[index][plan.group]
                group_index := int(#keys) - 1
                if group_index < 0 or schema_io.compare_cells(key, keys[group_index]) != 0
                    keys = keys.append(key)
                    groups = groups.append([])
                    group_index += 1
                groups[group_index] = groups[group_index].append(matched[index])
        for: group_index < int(#groups)
            string[] fields := []
            for: item_index < int(#plan.parsed.items)
                fields = fields.append(aggregate_value(plan.parsed.items[item_index], plan.item_columns[item_index], groups[group_index], keys[group_index]))
            output = output.append(fields.join(","))
    if plan.parsed.limit >= 0
        output = output[0:<math.min(plan.parsed.limit, int(#output))]
    return Result(kind, int(#matched), output)

string counts_text(int[] counts)
    names := ["row_groups_read", "row_groups_skipped", "pages_read", "pages_skipped", "pages_unneeded", "dictionary_pages_read", "bytes_read", "rows_scanned", "rows_matched"]
    return [for index := (int(0):<9)[] then "{names[index]} {counts[index]}"].join(" ")

void execute_queries(Store store, schema_io.Cell[][] originals, string[] queries)
    string[] result_lines := []
    string[] stats_lines := []
    totals := array(9, fill = 0)
    errors := 0
    checks_ok := 0
    for: query_index < int(#queries)
        number := query_index + 1
        checked := check_query(query.parse(queries[query_index]), store.columns)
        if checked.error_code != ""
            line := "query {number} error {checked.error_code}"
            result_lines = result_lines.append(line)
            stats_lines = stats_lines.append(line)
            errors += 1
            continue
        plan := checked.plan
        scanned := scan_store(store, plan)
        result := build_result(plan, scanned.rows)
        reference := build_result(plan, [for row := originals[] if evaluate(plan, row) == 1 then row])
        equal := result.kind == reference.kind and result.matched == reference.matched and result.lines == reference.lines
        if equal
            checks_ok += 1
        result_lines = result_lines.append("query {number} {result.kind} matched {result.matched} output {#result.lines}").append("columns " + plan.headers.join(",")).concat(result.lines)
        needed := [for index := plan.needed[] then store.columns[index].name].join(",")
        if needed == ""
            needed = "-"
        stats_lines = stats_lines.append("query {number} columns {needed} " + counts_text(scanned.counts) + " check " + (if equal then "ok" else "mismatch"))
        for: group_index < int(#store.groups)
            detail := if scanned.records[group_index] == "" then "skipped" else "pages " + scanned.records[group_index]
            stats_lines = stats_lines.append("query {number} row_group {group_index} {detail}")
        for: index < 9
            totals[index] += scanned.counts[index]
    stats_lines = stats_lines.append("total queries {#queries} errors {errors} " + counts_text(totals) + " checks_ok {checks_ok}")
    schema_io.write_lines("output/query_results.txt", result_lines)
    schema_io.write_lines("output/query_stats.txt", stats_lines)

void recover(int[] data)
    store := parse_file(data)
    rows := [for row := (0:<(store.rows))[] then array(#store.columns, fill = schema_io.Cell(unknown = true))]
    lines := ["file bytes {#data} rows {store.rows} columns {#store.columns} row_groups {#store.groups}"]
    for: index < int(#store.columns)
        lines = lines.append(column_line(index, store.columns[index]))
    pages_examined := 0
    damaged_pages := 0
    lost_pages := 0
    lost_cells := 0
    for: group_index < int(#store.groups)
        group := store.groups[group_index]
        for: column_number < int(#store.columns)
            column := store.columns[column_number]
            chunk := group.chunks[column_number]
            schema_io.Cell[] dictionary := []
            dictionary_damaged := false
            Page[] pages := if chunk.has_dictionary then [chunk.dictionary].concat(chunk.pages) else chunk.pages
            data_index := 0
            row := group.first_row
            for page := pages[]
                pages_examined += 1
                checksum := bitstream.adler32(page_body(store, page))
                damaged := checksum != page.checksum
                label := if page.kind == 1 then "dict" else "{data_index}"
                if damaged
                    damaged_pages += 1
                    lines = lines.append("damaged {group_index} {column.name} {label} offset {page.offset} stored {schema_io.hex_text(page.checksum, 8)} computed {schema_io.hex_text(checksum, 8)}")
                if page.kind == 1
                    dictionary_damaged = damaged
                    if not damaged
                        dictionary = decode_dictionary(store, column, page)
                    continue
                reason := if damaged then "checksum" elif page.method == 1 and dictionary_damaged then "dictionary" else ""
                if reason != ""
                    lost_pages += 1
                    lost_cells += page.values
                    lines = lines.append("lost {group_index} {column.name} {data_index} rows {page.values} reason {reason}")
                else
                    values := decode_page(store, column, page, dictionary)
                    for: index < page.values
                        rows[row + index][column_number] = values[index]
                row += page.values
                data_index += 1
    recovered_cells := store.rows * int(#store.columns) - lost_cells
    lines = lines.append("summary pages {pages_examined} damaged {damaged_pages} lost_pages {lost_pages} lost_cells {lost_cells} recovered_cells {recovered_cells}")
    recovered := [[for column := store.columns[] then column.name].join(",")]
    for row := rows[]
        recovered = recovered.append([for value := row[] then schema_io.cell_text(value, "")].join(","))
    schema_io.write_lines("output/recovery.txt", lines)
    schema_io.write_lines("output/recovered.csv", recovered)

void run_program()
    inputs := schema_io.read_inputs()
    built := build_file(inputs)
    store := parse_file(built.data)
    string[] hexadecimal := []
    offset := 0
    while offset < int(#built.data)
        end := math.min(offset + 32, int(#built.data))
        hexadecimal = hexadecimal.append([for index := (offset:<end)[] then schema_io.hex_text(built.data[index], 2)].join(""))
        offset = end
    schema_io.write_lines("output/file.hex", hexadecimal)
    schema_io.write_lines("output/encoding_report.csv", built.report)
    schema_io.write_lines("output/metadata.txt", describe(store, inputs.rows))
    execute_queries(store, inputs.rows, inputs.queries)
    recover(inputs.damaged)

if main
    run_program()

import schema_io = "./schema_io.qui"

class Item(string operation, string name)
class Condition(string operation, name := "", schema_io.Cell[] literals := [], left := -1, right := -1)
class Parsed(Item[] items, Condition[] nodes, int root, string group, string order, bool descending, int limit)
class State(string[] tokens)
    position := 0
    Condition[] nodes := []

string[] tokenize(string text)
    string[] result := []
    position := 0
    while position < int(#text)
        if text[position] == " "
            position += 1
            continue
        start := position
        character := text[position]
        position += 1
        if character == "'"
            while text[position] != "'"
                position += 1
            position += 1
        elif "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_".contains(character)
            while position < int(#text) and "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_0123456789".contains(text[position])
                position += 1
        elif character == "-" or "0123456789".contains(character)
            while position < int(#text) and "0123456789".contains(text[position])
                position += 1
        elif position < int(#text) and ((character == "<" and (text[position] == "=" or text[position] == ">")) or (character == ">" and text[position] == "="))
            position += 1
        result = result.append(text[start:<position])
    return result

string peek(State state)
    return if state.position < int(#state.tokens) then state.tokens[state.position] else ""

string take(State &state)
    result := state.tokens[state.position]
    state.position += 1
    return result

bool accept(State &state, string token)
    if peek(state) != token
        return false
    state.position += 1
    return true

int insert_node(State &state, Condition node)
    result := int(#state.nodes)
    state.nodes = state.nodes.append(node)
    return result

schema_io.Cell read_literal(State &state)
    token := take(&state)
    if token.starts_with("'")
        return schema_io.Cell(false, text = token[1:<int(#token) - 1], kind = "STRING")
    if token == "TRUE" or token == "FALSE"
        return schema_io.Cell(false, if token == "TRUE" then 1 else 0, kind = "BOOL")
    return schema_io.Cell(false, int(token), kind = "INT")

int condition(State &state);
int negation(State &state);

int negation(State &state)
    if accept(&state, "NOT")
        child := negation(&state)
        return insert_node(&state, Condition("NOT", left = child))
    if accept(&state, "(")
        child := condition(&state)
        take(&state)
        return child
    column_name := take(&state)
    operation := take(&state)
    schema_io.Cell[] literals := []
    if operation == "IS"
        operation = if accept(&state, "NOT") then "IS_NOT_NULL" else "IS_NULL"
        take(&state)
    elif operation == "BETWEEN"
        literals = literals.append(read_literal(&state))
        take(&state)
        literals = literals.append(read_literal(&state))
    elif operation == "IN"
        take(&state)
        literals = literals.append(read_literal(&state))
        while accept(&state, ",")
            literals = literals.append(read_literal(&state))
        take(&state)
    else
        literals = literals.append(read_literal(&state))
    return insert_node(&state, Condition(operation, column_name, literals))

int conjunction(State &state)
    result := negation(&state)
    while accept(&state, "AND")
        right := negation(&state)
        result = insert_node(&state, Condition("AND", left = result, right = right))
    return result

int condition(State &state)
    result := conjunction(&state)
    while accept(&state, "OR")
        right := conjunction(&state)
        result = insert_node(&state, Condition("OR", left = result, right = right))
    return result

Item item(State &state)
    token := take(&state)
    if "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".contains(token[0])
        return Item("COLUMN", token)
    take(&state)
    operation := if accept(&state, "DISTINCT") then "COUNT_DISTINCT" else token
    column_name := take(&state)
    take(&state)
    return Item(operation, if column_name == "*" then "" else column_name)

Parsed parse(string text)
    state := State(tokenize(text))
    take(&state)
    Item[] items := []
    if not accept(&state, "*")
        items = items.append(item(&state))
        while accept(&state, ",")
            items = items.append(item(&state))
    root := if accept(&state, "WHERE") then condition(&state) else -1
    group := ""
    order := ""
    descending := false
    limit := -1
    if accept(&state, "GROUP")
        take(&state)
        group = take(&state)
    if accept(&state, "ORDER")
        take(&state)
        order = take(&state)
        if accept(&state, "DESC")
            descending = true
        else
            accept(&state, "ASC")
    if accept(&state, "LIMIT")
        limit = int(take(&state))
    return Parsed(items, state.nodes, root, group, order, descending, limit)

class Cell(is_null := true, number := 0, text := "", kind := "", unknown := false)
class Column(string name, string kind, bool nullable)
class Options(int row_group_size, int page_size, int dictionary_limit, string[] methods)
class Inputs(Column[] columns, Cell[][] rows, Options settings, string[] queries, int[] damaged)

string[] read_lines(string path)
    string[] result := []
    source := file.read(path)
    while .source(string &line)
        result = result.append(line)
    return result

void write_lines(string path, string[] lines)
    target := file.write(path)
    for line := lines[]
        .target.line(line)

bool leap(int year)
    return year % 4 == 0 and (year % 100 != 0 or year % 400 == 0)

int month_days(int year, int month)
    lengths := [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
    return lengths[month - 1] + (if month == 2 and leap(year) then 1 else 0)

int day_number(string text)
    year := int(text[0:<4])
    month := int(text[5:<7])
    int result := int(text[8:<10]) - 1 - 7305
    for: 1950 <= current < year
        result += if leap(current) then 366 else 365
    for: 1 <= current < month
        result += month_days(year, current)
    return result

string padded(int value, int width)
    result := "{value}"
    while int(#result) < width
        result = "0" + result
    return result

string date_text(int value)
    rest := value + 7305
    year := 1950
    while rest >= (if leap(year) then 366 else 365)
        rest -= if leap(year) then 366 else 365
        year += 1
    month := 1
    while rest >= month_days(year, month)
        rest -= month_days(year, month)
        month += 1
    return padded(year, 4) + "-" + padded(month, 2) + "-" + padded(rest + 1, 2)

Cell parse_cell(string kind, string text)
    if text == ""
        return Cell(kind = kind)
    if kind == "STRING"
        return Cell(false, text = text, kind = kind)
    if kind == "BOOL"
        return Cell(false, if text == "true" then 1 else 0, kind = kind)
    int number := if kind == "DATE" then day_number(text) else int(text)
    return Cell(false, number, kind = kind)

string cell_text(Cell cell, null_text := "NULL")
    if cell.unknown
        return "?"
    if cell.is_null
        return null_text
    if cell.kind == "STRING"
        return cell.text
    if cell.kind == "BOOL"
        return if cell.number == 1 then "true" else "false"
    if cell.kind == "DATE"
        return date_text(cell.number)
    return "{cell.number}"

int compare_cells(Cell first, Cell second)
    if first.is_null or second.is_null
        return if first.is_null == second.is_null then 0 elif first.is_null then -1 else 1
    if first.kind == "STRING"
        if first.text == second.text
            return 0
        return if [first.text, second.text].sorted()[0] == first.text then -1 else 1
    return if first.number == second.number then 0 elif first.number < second.number then -1 else 1

int[] ascii_bytes(string text)
    return text.codepoints()

string ascii_text(int[] data)
    nat8[] bytes := nat8(data)
    return string.from_utf8(bin(bytes))

int hexadecimal_digit(string text)
    alphabet := "0123456789abcdef"
    for: index < 16
        if alphabet[index] == text
            return index
    return 0

string hex_text(int value, int width)
    hex := if value > 0 then value.b16 else "0"
    return if #hex < width then "0" * (width - #hex) + hex else hex

Inputs read_inputs()
    Column[] columns := []
    for line := read_lines("input/schema.txt")[]
        words := line.split(" ")
        columns = columns.append(Column(words[0], words[1], words[2] == "NULLABLE"))
    Cell[][] rows := []
    csv := read_lines("input/table.csv")
    for: 1 <= row < int(#csv)
        fields := csv[row].split(",")
        rows = rows.append([for column := (0:<(int(#columns)))[] then parse_cell(columns[column].kind, fields[column])])
    settings := read_lines("input/options.txt")
    methods := [for column := (0:<(int(#columns)))[] then settings[column + 3].split(" ")[2]]
    options := Options(int(settings[0].split(" ")[1]), int(settings[1].split(" ")[1]), int(settings[2].split(" ")[1]), methods)
    int[] damaged := []
    for line := read_lines("input/damaged.hex")[]
        offset := 0
        while offset < int(#line)
            damaged = damaged.append(hexadecimal_digit(line[offset]) * 16 + hexadecimal_digit(line[offset + 1]))
            offset += 2
    return Inputs(columns, rows, options, read_lines("input/queries.txt"), damaged)
